meta.title: Session Suite
meta.description: Rewind a session to any message with its files and memory, delete sessions permanently, and export or share conversations.

menu.shareEmpty: This session has no messages to share yet

message.rewindBody: This restores the workspace files and session memory saved for this step, forks the conversation up to this message, and archives the current session. An undo snapshot is kept for 10 minutes.
message.deleteBody: This rewinds the conversation to the message before it, so the message and everything after it leave the conversation. Workspace files and memory are restored to that point too.

dialog.deleteSessionBody: The session and everything inside it will be removed from local storage, including its conversation log, snapshots, and memory. This cannot be undone.
dialog.deleteSessionOnlyBody: This is the only message in the session. Deleting it also deletes the session.
dialog.sessionRunning: This session is running. Stop it before deleting.

settings.title: Session snapshots
settings.description: Workspace checkpoints captured for the current session, with disk usage, locking, and restore controls.
settings.empty: No snapshots yet. A checkpoint is captured at the start of each turn.
settings.restoreBody: Only the workspace files recorded in this snapshot are rewritten. The conversation is not changed.
settings.undoHint: Available for 10 minutes after a rollback.
settings.memoryEmpty: Nothing remembered in this session yet.
settings.memoryPlaceholder: A durable fact, rule, or preference
settings.memoryHint: Entries added after a rollback point are removed when you rewind.
